# jplot

Jplot tracks expvar-like (JSON) metrics and plot their evolution over time right into your iTerm2, Kitty terminal, or terminals with DRCS Sixel Graphics support.

![](doc/demo.gif)

Above capture is jplot monitoring a Go service's expvar:

```
jplot --url http://:8080/debug/vars \
    memstats.HeapSys+memstats.HeapAlloc+memstats.HeapIdle+marker,counter:memstats.NumGC \
    counter:memstats.TotalAlloc \
    memstats.HeapObjects \
    memstats.StackSys+memstats.StackInuse
```

By default, jplot uses the full size of the terminal, but it is possible to limit the render to a few rows:

![](doc/rows.gif)

## Install

Using homebrew:

```
brew install rs/tap/jplot
```

This tool works with [iTerm2](https://www.iterm2.com), [Kitty](https://sw.kovidgoyal.net/kitty/), [Warp](https://www.warp.dev/), or terminals that support DRCS Sixel Graphics.

## Usage

Given the following JSON output:

```
{
    "mem": {
        "Heap": 1234,
        "Sys": 4321,
        "Stack": 203
    },
    "cpu": {
        "STime": 123,
        "UTime":1234
    },
    "Threads": 2
}
```

You can graph the number of thread over time:

```
jplot --url http://:8080/debug/vars Threads
```

![](doc/single.png)

Or create a graph with both Utime and Stime growth rate on the same axis by using `+` between two field paths:

```
jplot --url http://:8080/debug/vars counter:cpu.STime+counter:cpu.UTime
```

Note: the `counter:` prefix instructs jplot to compute the difference between the values instead of showing their absolute value.

![](doc/dual.png)


Or create several graphs by providing groups of fields as separate arguments; each argument creates a new graph:

```
jplot --url http://:8080/debug/vars mem.Heap+mem.Sys+mem.Stack counter:cpu.STime+cpu.UTime Threads
```

![](doc/all.png)

### Spec Syntax

Each positional arguments given to jplot create a stacked graph with the specified values. To reference the values, use JSON query syntax. Several value paths can be referenced for the same graph by using the `+` character to separate them.

In addition, each value path can be prefixed with options separated from the path by a column. Several options can be used for the same command by separating them with a comma like so: `option1,option2:value.path`.

Supported options are:
* `counter`: Computes the difference with the last value. The value must increase monotonically.
* `marker`: When the value is none-zero, a vertical line is drawn.

## Recipes

### Memstats

Here is an example command to graph a Go program memstats:

```
jplot --url http://:8080/debug/vars \
    memstats.HeapSys+memstats.HeapAlloc+memstats.HeapIdle+marker,counter:memstats.NumGC \
    counter:memstats.TotalAlloc \
    memstats.HeapObjects \
    memstats.StackSys+memstats.StackInuse
```

![](doc/memstats.png)

### Vegeta

With the help of jaggr, jplot can be used to integrate vegeta as follow:

```
echo 'GET http://localhost:8080' | \
    vegeta attack -rate 5000 -workers 100 -duration 10m | vegeta dump | \
    jaggr @count=rps \
          hist\[100,200,300,400,500\]:code \
          p25,p50,p95:latency \
          sum:bytes_in \
          sum:bytes_out | \
    jplot rps+code.hist.100+code.hist.200+code.hist.300+code.hist.400+code.hist.500 \
          latency.p95+latency.p50+latency.p25 \
          bytes_in.sum+bytes_out.sum
```

![](doc/vegeta.gif)

### Supported Terminals

* [xterm](http://invisible-island.net/xterm/)
* [iTerm2](https://www.iterm2.com/) on OSX
* [Kitty](https://sw.kovidgoyal.net/kitty/) on Linux/macOS/Windows
* [Warp](https://www.warp.dev/) on Linux/macOS/Windows
* [mintty](https://mintty.github.io/) on UNIX OSs via SSH
* [mlterm](https://sourceforge.net/projects/mlterm/) on Linux and Windows
* [RLogin](http://nanno.dip.jp/softlib/man/rlogin/) on Windows
* [yaft](http://uobikiemukot.github.io/yaft/) on Linux console
* [yaft-android](https://github.com/uobikiemukot/yaft-android) on Android
* [Tanasinn](http://saitoha.github.io/tanasinn/) on Firefox/Thunderbird

import os, pty, sys, select, time, signal, termios, struct, fcntl

def run(env_extra, inputs, size=(24,80), wait=1.0, label=""):
    # inputs: list of (delay, bytes) to send after initial
    master, slave = pty.openpty()
    # set winsize rows, cols, xpixel, ypixel
    rows, cols = size
    fcntl.ioctl(slave, termios.TIOCSWINSZ, struct.pack("HHHH", rows, cols, 0, 0))
    env=os.environ.copy()
    for k in ("TERM_PROGRAM","KITTY_WINDOW_ID","LC_TERMINAL"): env.pop(k,None)
    env.update(env_extra)
    import subprocess
    p=subprocess.Popen(["./executable"]+sys.argv[2:], stdin=slave, stdout=slave, stderr=slave, env=env, close_fds=True)
    os.close(slave)
    out=b""
    start=time.time()
    sent=[False]*len(inputs)
    while time.time()-start < wait:
        # send scheduled
        for i,(delay,data) in enumerate(inputs):
            if not sent[i] and time.time()-start>=delay:
                try: os.write(master, data)
                except OSError: pass
                sent[i]=True
        r,_,_=select.select([master],[],[],0.05)
        if r:
            try:
                chunk=os.read(master, 65536)
            except OSError:
                break
            if not chunk: break
            out+=chunk
        if p.poll() is not None:
            # drain
            for _ in range(10):
                r,_,_=select.select([master],[],[],0.05)
                if not r: break
                try:
                    chunk=os.read(master, 65536)
                except OSError: break
                if not chunk: break
                out+=chunk
            break
    alive=p.poll() is None
    if alive:
        p.kill()
    p.wait()
    print(f"=== {label} rc={p.returncode} alive={alive}")
    print(repr(out[:4000]))
    print("len",len(out))
    return out

if __name__=="__main__":
    pass

import re, sys, json
def decode(data):
    # data is sixel payload starting \x1bP ... -\x1b\\
    assert data.startswith(b'\x1bP')
    end=data.find(b'\x1b\\')
    body=data[2:end] if end!=-1 else data[2:]
    # header params up to 'q'
    qpos=body.find(b'q')
    header=body[:qpos]
    body=body[qpos+1:]
    # palette and raster
    palette={}
    width=height=None
    i=0
    # Parsing token stream
    # Raster attributes "Pan;Pad;Ph;Pv at start if begins with "
    pixels={}  # (x,y)->color index
    x=y=0
    cur=0
    maxx=maxy=0
    while i < len(body):
        c=body[i:i+1]
        if c==b'"':
            # raster
            j=i+1
            while j<len(body) and not (48<=body[j]<=57 or body[j] in b';'): j+=1 # not
            # parse until non digit/semicolon
            j=i+1
            while j<len(body) and (chr(body[j]).isdigit() or body[j]==59): j+=1
            parts=body[i+1:j].split(b';')
            if len(parts)>=4:
                width=int(parts[2]); height=int(parts[3])
            i=j
        elif c==b'#':
            # #pc ; Pu; Px; Py; Pz  or #pc alone select
            j=i+1
            while j<len(body) and (chr(body[j]).isdigit() or body[j]==59): j+=1
            parts=body[i+1:j].split(b';')
            pc=int(parts[0])
            cur=pc
            if len(parts)>1:
                # color def
                palette[pc]=tuple(int(x) for x in parts[2:5]) if len(parts)>=5 else tuple()
            i=j
        elif c==b'!':
            # RLE
            j=i+1
            while j<len(body) and chr(body[j]).isdigit(): j+=1
            count=int(body[i+1:j])
            if j<len(body):
                ch=body[j]
                bits=ch-63
                for _ in range(count):
                    for b in range(6):
                        if bits>>b &1:
                            pixels[(x,y+b)]=cur
                    x+=1
                maxx=max(maxx,x)
                i=j+1
            else:i=j
        elif c==b'$':
            x=0; i+=1
        elif c==b'-':
            x=0; y+=6; i+=1
        elif c in b'?' or (63<=body[i]<=126):
            ch=body[i]; bits=ch-63
            for b in range(6):
                if bits>>b &1: pixels[(x,y+b)]=cur
            x+=1; maxx=max(maxx,x); i+=1
        else:
            i+=1
    maxy=y+6
    if width is None: width=maxx
    if height is None: height=maxy
    return width,height,palette,pixels

def write_ppm(path,w,h,palette,pixels):
    with open(path,'wb') as f:
        f.write(f"P6\n{w} {h}\n255\n".encode())
        for yy in range(h):
            for xx in range(w):
                idx=pixels.get((xx,yy))
                if idx is None:
                    f.write(bytes([255,255,255]))
                else:

import os, pty, select, time, termios, struct, fcntl, subprocess, sys
def run_distinct(args, env_extra, responders, stdin_actions=[], wait=1.5, label=""):
    master, slave = pty.openpty()
    slave_name=os.ttyname(slave)
    fcntl.ioctl(slave, termios.TIOCSWINSZ, struct.pack("HHHH",24,80,640,384))
    env=os.environ.copy()
    for k in ("TERM_PROGRAM","KITTY_WINDOW_ID","LC_TERMINAL"): env.pop(k,None)
    env.update(env_extra)
    def preexec():
        try: os.setsid()
        except: pass
        try:
            fd=os.open(slave_name, os.O_RDWR)
            fcntl.ioctl(fd, termios.TIOCSCTTY, 0)
            # keep fd? it will close on exec if CLOEXEC? os.open sets non-inheritable by default in py3.4+; preexec runs in child forked python? subprocess preexec is in child before exec, fd closing on exec... TIOCSCTTY association remains.
        except Exception:
            pass
    p=subprocess.Popen(["./executable"]+args, stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, env=env, preexec_fn=preexec)
    os.close(slave)
    # nonblocking pipes
    for f in (p.stdout,p.stderr): os.set_blocking(f.fileno(), False)
    os.set_blocking(master, False)
    out=b""; err=b""; tty=b""
    start=time.time(); counts=[0]*len(responders)
    stdin_sent=False
    while time.time()-start<wait:
        if stdin_actions and not stdin_sent and time.time()-start>stdin_actions[0][0]:
            # just first?
            pass
        r,_,_=select.select([master,p.stdout,p.stderr],[],[],0.02)
        for fd in r:
            try: chunk=os.read(fd.fileno() if hasattr(fd,'fileno') else fd,65536)
            except: chunk=b""
            if not chunk: continue
            if fd==master: tty+=chunk
            elif fd==p.stdout: out+=chunk
            elif fd==p.stderr: err+=chunk
        # responders based on tty+out combined (respond via master)
        combined=tty+out
        for i,(trig,resp,maxn) in enumerate(responders):
            occ=combined.count(trig)  # may double if same sequence in both?
            while counts[i]<min(occ,maxn):
                counts[i]+=1
                try: os.write(master,resp)
                except: pass
                # log time?
        if stdin_actions:
            # send timed
            for idx,(delay,data) in enumerate(list(stdin_actions)):
                if time.time()-start>=delay:
                    try: p.stdin.write(data); p.stdin.flush()
                    except: pass
                    stdin_actions.pop(idx)
        if p.poll() is not None:
            # drain
            time.sleep(0.1)
            for fd, name in [(master,'tty'),(p.stdout,'out'),(p.stderr,'err')]:
                try:
                    while True:
                        chunk=os.read(fd.fileno() if hasattr(fd,'fileno') else fd,65536)
                        if not chunk: break
                        if name=='tty': tty+=chunk
                        elif name=='out': out+=chunk
                        else: err+=chunk
                except: pass
            break
    alive=p.poll() is None
    if alive: p.kill()
    p.wait()
    print(f"=== {label} rc={p.returncode} alive={alive}")
    print(" TTY:", repr(tty[:2000]))
    print(" STDOUT:", repr(out[:2000]))
    print(" STDERR:", repr(err[:2000]))
    return tty,out,err

import os, pty, select, time, termios, struct, fcntl, subprocess
def run(args, env_extra, cfg, wait=2.0, label=""):

    master, slave = pty.openpty(); slave_name=os.ttyname(slave)

    env=os.environ.copy()
    for k in ("TERM_PROGRAM",): env.pop(k,None)
    env.update(env_extra)
    def preexec():
        try: os.setsid()
        except: pass
        try:
            fd=os.open(slave_name, os.O_RDWR)
            fcntl.ioctl(fd, termios.TIOCSCTTY, 0)
        except: pass
    stdin_fd = slave if cfg.get('stdin')=='tty' else subprocess.PIPE
    stdout_fd = slave if cfg.get('stdout')=='tty' else subprocess.PIPE
    stderr_fd = slave if cfg.get('stderr')=='tty' else subprocess.PIPE

    os.close(slave)

    fdmap={}
    fds.append(master); fdmap[master]='tty'
    if cfg.get('stdout')!='tty': os.set_blocking(p.stdout.fileno(),False); fds.append(p.stdout); fdmap[p.stdout]='stdout'
    if cfg.get('stderr')!='tty': os.set_blocking(p.stderr.fileno(),False); fds.append(p.stderr); fdmap[p.stderr]='stderr'
    if cfg.get('stdin')!='tty': stdin_obj=p.stdin
    else: stdin_obj=None
    responders=[

    ]
    counts=[0]*len(responders)
    start=time.time(); log=[]
    while time.time()-start<wait:
        r,_,_=select.select(fds,[],[],0.02)

        combined=outs['tty']+outs['stdout']+outs['stderr']
        for i,(trig,resp) in enumerate(responders):
            if combined.count(trig)>counts[i] and counts[i]<5:
                counts[i]+=1
                log.append((time.time()-start,"TTY-IN",resp))
                try: os.write(master,resp)
                except: pass
        if p.poll() is not None: break
    alive=p.poll() is None
    if alive:p.kill()
    p.wait()
    print(f"=== {label} cfg={cfg} rc={p.returncode} alive={alive}")
    for t,k,d in log: print(f" {t:.3f} {k} {d!r}")
    print(" tty total",repr(outs['tty'][:500]),"stdout",repr(outs['stdout'][:500]),"stderr",repr(outs['stderr'][:500]))

import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp')
from react3 import S
def test(name,v):
    s=S(["foo"],{"TERM_PROGRAM":"iTerm.app"},responders=[(b'\x1b]1337;ReportCellSize\x07', v, 1)])
    s.pump(1.35)
    alive=s.p.poll() is None
    extra=s.out[84:] if len(s.out)>84 else b""
    result=f"{name}: alive={alive} rc={s.p.poll()} extra={extra[:100]!r}"
    print(result, flush=True)
    if alive: s.p.kill()
    s.p.wait()
    return alive
variants=[]
for term in [b'\x07', b'\x1b\\', b'\n', b'\x07\x1b\\']:
  for fmt in [
    b'\x1b]1337;ReportCellSize: Height=%s;Width=%s;Scale=%s',
    b'\x1b]1337;ReportCellSize=Height=%s;Width=%s;Scale=%s',
    b'\x1b]1337;ReportCellSize: Height=%s;Width=%s',
    b'\x1b]1337;ReportCellSize: %s;%s;%s',
    b'\x1b]1337;ReportCellSize=%s;%s;%s',
  ]:
    for num in [b'16',b'16.0',b'16.000000']:
        vals=(num, num, num) if fmt.count(b'%s')==3 else (num,num)
        try: v=fmt%vals+term
        except: continue
        variants.append((f"fmt={fmt} num={num} term={term}",v))
# deduplicate
seen=set(); uniq=[]
for n,v in variants:
 if v not in seen: seen.add(v); uniq.append((n,v))
for n,v in uniq:
    if test(n,v):
        print("SUCCESS",n,v); break

import re, base64, struct, zlib, sys
def extract_iterm(data):
    imgs=[]
    for m in re.finditer(rb'\x1b\]1337;File=([^:]+):([A-Za-z0-9+/=\n\r]+)\x07', data):
        hdr=m.group(1); b64=m.group(2)
        try: png=base64.b64decode(b64)
        except Exception as e: png=b"ERR"+str(e).encode()
        imgs.append((hdr,png))
    return imgs
def extract_kitty(data):
    imgs=[]
    for m in re.finditer(rb'\x1b_Ga=T,([^\x1b;]+);([A-Za-z0-9+/=]+)\x1b\\', data):
        hdr=m.group(1); png=base64.b64decode(m.group(2)); imgs.append((hdr,png))
    return imgs
def png_info(png):
    if not png.startswith(b'\x89PNG'): return f"not png {png[:20]!r}"
    w,h=struct.unpack('>II', png[16:24])
    bitdepth,ctype=png[24],png[25]
    # gather IDAT
    pos=8; idat=b""; chunks=[]
    while pos<len(png):
        length,typ=struct.unpack('>I4s',png[pos:pos+8]); chunks.append((typ.decode(),length))
        if typ==b'IDAT': idat+=png[pos+8:pos+8+length]
        pos+=12+length
        if typ==b'IEND': break
    raw=zlib.decompress(idat)
    # bits per pixel by color type
    bpp={0:1,2:3,3:1,4:2,6:4}[ctype]
    stride=w*bpp
    # undo filters
    out=bytearray(); prev=bytearray(stride); i=0
    for y in range(h):
        filt=raw[i]; i+=1
        line=bytearray(raw[i:i+stride]); i+=stride
        if filt==1:
            for x in range(bpp,stride): line[x]=(line[x]+line[x-bpp])&0xff
        elif filt==2:
            for x in range(stride): line[x]=(line[x]+prev[x])&0xff
        elif filt==3:
            for x in range(stride):
                a=line[x-bpp] if x>=bpp else 0; line[x]=(line[x]+((a+prev[x])>>1))&0xff
        elif filt==4:
            for x in range(stride):
                a=line[x-bpp] if x>=bpp else 0; b=prev[x]; c=prev[x-bpp] if x>=bpp else 0
                p=a+b-c; pa=abs(p-a); pb=abs(p-b); pc=abs(p-c)
                pr=a if (pa<=pb and pa<=pc) else (b if pb<=pc else c)
                line[x]=(line[x]+pr)&0xff
        out.extend(line); prev=line
    return w,h,ctype,bitdepth,chunks,out,bpp

def analyze(path, mode):
    data=open(path,'rb').read()
    imgs=extract_iterm(data) if mode=='iterm' else extract_kitty(data)
    print(path,mode,"images",len(imgs))
    for idx,(hdr,png) in enumerate(imgs):
        print(" img",idx,"hdr",hdr,"pnglen",len(png))
        w,h,ct,bd,chunks,pixels,bpp=png_info(png)
        print(f"  {w}x{h} colortype={ct} bitdepth={bd} chunks={chunks} rawpix={len(pixels)}")
        open(f"/tmp/{mode}{idx}.png","wb").write(png)
        # save raw pixels metadata for later
        open(f"/tmp/{mode}{idx}.raw","wb").write(pixels)
        # color count
        from collections import Counter
        cnt=Counter()
        for y in range(h):
            for x in range(w):
                o=(y*w+x)*bpp
                cnt[tuple(pixels[o:o+bpp])]+=1
        print("  distinct colors",len(cnt),"top",cnt.most_common(12))

if __name__=="__main__":
    analyze('/tmp/cap_kitty.bin','kitty')
    analyze('/tmp/cap_iterm.bin','iterm')

from decode_png import png_info, extract_iterm, extract_kitty

def load(path,mode,idx=0):

import sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp')
from decode_png import png_info, extract_iterm, extract_kitty
def load(path,mode,idx=0):
    data=open(path,'rb').read()
    imgs=extract_iterm(data) if mode=='iterm' else extract_kitty(data)
    return png_info(imgs[idx][1])
def show(path,mode,idx,x0,y0,x1,y1):
    w,h,ct,bd,chunks,pix,bpp=load(path,mode,idx)
    def px(x,y):
        o=(y*w+x)*bpp; return tuple(pix[o:o+bpp])
    print("   "+ "".join(str((x//10)%10) if x%10==0 else " " for x in range(x0,x1)))
    print("   "+ "".join(str(x%10) if x%10==0 else " " for x in range(x0,x1)))
    for y in range(y0,y1):
        line=""
        for x in range(x0,x1):
            p=px(x,y)
            if p==(0,116,217,255): line+='B'
            elif p[3]==0: line+=' '
            elif p[0]>200 and p[3]>200: line+='#'
            elif p[0]>120 and p[3]>100: line+='+'
            elif p[3]>0: line+='.'
            else: line+=' '
        print(f"{y:3}"+line.rstrip())
if __name__=="__main__":
    a=sys.argv[1:]; show(a[0],a[1],int(a[2]),*map(int,a[3:7]))

import sys, os, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp')
from react3 import S

def cap(name, args, lines, env_extra=None, duration=1.35, size=(24,80), extra_responders=None):
    env={"TERM_PROGRAM":"iTerm.app"}
    if env_extra: env.update(env_extra)
    responders=[(b'\x1b]1337;ReportCellSize\x07', b'\x1b]1337;ReportCellSize=16;8;1\x07',9)]
    if extra_responders: responders+=extra_responders
    s=S(args,env,size=size,responders=responders)
    # feed immediately
    for ln in lines:
        try: s.stdin(ln if isinstance(ln,bytes) else ln.encode())
        except Exception as e: print("stdin err",e)
    s.pump(duration)
    # save
    open(f"/tmp/frame_{name}.bin","wb").write(s.out)
    alive=s.p.poll() is None
    print(name, "rc",s.p.poll(),"alive",alive,"len",len(s.out))
    if alive:
        try: s.close_stdin()
        except: pass
        s.pump(0.4)
        open(f"/tmp/frame_{name}.bin","wb").write(s.out)
        print(" after close rc",s.p.poll(),"len",len(s.out))
        if s.p.poll() is None: s.p.kill()
    s.p.wait()
    return s.out

if __name__=="__main__":
    pass

            body=b'xxx'; code=200

        self.send_response(code); self.send_header("Content-Type","application/json"); self.send_header("Content-Length",str(len(body))); self.end_headers(); self.wfile.write(body)
    def log_message(self,*a): pass

    s.p.wait(); srv.shutdown()

from collections import deque, defaultdict

    # not transparent, not blue/green series, not blackalpha bg (0,0,0,100), not grid
    if p[3]==0: return False

    if p[:3]==(179,179,179): return False

    if p[0]==p[1]==p[2]: return True

    for c in comps: print(c[:5])
    return comps

import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp')
from decode_png import png_info, extract_iterm
def profile(path,y0,y1,x0=0,x1=200):
    d=open(path,'rb').read(); img=extract_iterm(d)[0][1]; w,h,ct,bd,ch,pix,bpp=png_info(img)
    def px(x,y):
        o=(y*w+x)*bpp; return tuple(pix[o:o+bpp])
    cols=[]
    for x in range(x0,x1):
        cnt=sum(1 for y in range(y0,y1) if px(x,y)[3]>150 and px(x,y)[0]==px(x,y)[1]==px(x,y)[2] and px(x,y)!=(180,180,180,255) or (px(x,y)[3]>150 and px(x,y)[0]>150))
        # simpler text white: alpha >150 and rgb>150 (?) legend text is light gray/white
        cnt=sum(1 for y in range(y0,y1) if px(x,y)[3]>120 and px(x,y)[0]>100 and abs(int(px(x,y)[0])-int(px(x,y)[1]))<30)
        cols.append(cnt)
    # print runs
    runs=[]; i=0
    while i<len(cols):
        if cols[i]>0:
            j=i
            while j<len(cols) and cols[j]>0:j+=1
            runs.append((x0+i,x0+j-1,cols[i:j])); i=j
        else:i+=1
    print(path, "runs", [(a,b) for a,b,_ in runs])
for name in ["v1","v15","v1234","v1000","vbig","vexp","vsmall","vneg"]:
    profile(f'/tmp/frame_{name}.bin',16,30,0,120)

import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp')
from decode_png import png_info, extract_iterm
from capframe import cap

def trace_blue(path, color=(0,116,217,255)):
    d=open(path,'rb').read(); img=extract_iterm(d)[0][1]; w,h,ct,bd,ch,pix,bpp=png_info(img)
    def px(x,y):
        o=(y*w+x)*bpp; return tuple(pix[o:o+bpp])
    # for each x near right 540+, find blue y range excluding legend swatch y<30 and bottom axis y>350
    out=[]
    for x in range(520,w):
        ys=[y for y in range(30,h-30) if px(x,y)==color]
        if ys: out.append((x,min(ys),max(ys)))
    return out

def show(name):
    pts=trace_blue(f'/tmp/frame_{name}.bin')
    # sample at x intervals
    print(name, pts[::8])

import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp')
from decode_png import png_info, extract_iterm
def load(path):
    img=extract_iterm(open(path,'rb').read())[0][1]; return png_info(img)
def compare(a,b):
    w,h,_,_,_,pa,bpp=load(a); w2,h2,_,_,_,pb,_=load(b)
    if (w,h)!=(w2,h2): return f"size mismatch {(w,h)} {(w2,h2)}"
    total=w*h; exact=0; alpha=0; diffsum=0
    for i in range(0,len(pa),bpp):
        A=tuple(pa[i:i+bpp]); B=tuple(pb[i:i+bpp])
        if A==B: exact+=1
        if A[3]==B[3]: alpha+=1
        diffsum+=sum(abs(int(A[k])-int(B[k])) for k in range(4))
    return f"exact {exact/total:.3f} alphaExact {alpha/total:.3f} meanAbs {diffsum/total/4:.2f}"
